title: What If the Universe Ended in a Big Rip?

scenes.text: What if the universe ended by tearing itself apart? One theory gives a countdown.
It needs dark energy to keep getting stronger. In one model, that ends everything in about 20 billion years.
Sixty million years before the end, our galaxy is ripped apart.
Three months before the end, the planets slip free of the Sun.
Thirty minutes before the end, Earth itself explodes.
In the last split second, even atoms come apart. It is only a theory, and most evidence does not demand it.

description:
What if the universe ended in a Big Rip?
One model of dark energy counts down from galaxies to atoms.
What should we run through next?
first_comment: Would you rather the universe end in a Big Rip or fade out cold? Drop your own 'what if'.
